title: Ground Beef German Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with ground beef and savory German flavors.
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add chopped onion, toasted caraway seeds, sweet paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet. Cook until onion is translucent.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add beef broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked egg noodles, ground beef mixture, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Remove foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until top is lightly browned.
